airflow.note: Table 26 and Table 12 - one built-in fan with front-to-back (AFO) cooling, cold air entering the front vents and leaving the rear. The overview says back-to-front can be ordered but the guide lists no part number or figure for it, so no back-to-front configuration is modelled.

built-in-power-and-fans.note: Tables 3, 12 and 26 and the rear callouts name a built-in 65 W AC power supply and a built-in fan, and Table 45 lists the switch "with in-built fans and power supply". The cooling overview says once that the fan modules are hot-removable field-replaceable units, but the guide has no removal or replacement procedure for a fan or a supply (its Maintain Components chapter covers transceivers and fibre only), names no part number for either, the rear callouts call them built in, and the image shows a round grille flush with the panel with no handle, latch or module outline. They are taken as part of the chassis, not bays and not components.

chassis.note: Tables 13 and 18 - height 1.72 in (4.37 cm), width 17.36 in (44.09 cm), depth 10.1 in (25.65 cm), weight 3520 g. The width is the body between the bracket fold lines; the guide gives no 19 in figure and the images show no ears. The depth 256.5 mm is the centimetre figure.

claim-label.note: Figure 18 callout 10 - the claim code label is a sticker at the left of the face, marked by two corner marks at 3.9 to 20.8 mm across and 24.3 to 39.5 down. It is a region and is not drawn.

colour.note: The face colour is the 48T photograph's median of the bare front, #acb2bc, carried at #a3a8af, a little under the studio light, as the library does; Figure 16 reads the same.

drawing-vs-photo.note: The legends are drawn from Figure 16: the model line reads EX4100-F in white with no PoE mark, and the jack and cage numbers are white. The maker's logo and Mist AI mark beside the model line are not drawn and are reserved as a logo-zone. The top vent field is short and the lower vent runs only under the right end, as on the 48T.

earthing.note: Table 46 and Figure 96 - a protective earthing terminal on the rear panel for a Panduit LCD10-14A-L lug on two M5 by 10 mm screws, which are separately orderable. The image shows two bare holes on a lighter plate 15.7 mm apart (the 5/8 in lug pitch is 15.9) and no screws, so they are drawn as holes on the plate and no two-hole seat is offered.

lamp-size.note: The cage lamp windows are placed as common/led-arrow-sm@1 (2.25 by 2.0 mm). The image shows triangles about 2.8 by 2.6 mm, which common/led-arrow@1 (3.6 by 3.2) would match, but two of those overlap at the 2.95 mm step the image gives, so the smaller part is used.

mounting.note: Table 4 and the mounting topics - the 2-post kit SRX34X-RMK ships in the box (front-mounting brackets, two in Table 45), the four-post kit EX-4PST-RMK and the wall kit EX-WMK are orderable. The four-post kit also holds 2 in recessed front brackets, so a recess of 50.8 mm is the one measured position. No kit is listed under chassis.kits in this change, and none of the kit part numbers is modelled.

port-lamps.note: Figures 30 to 32 and Table 24 - each jack and each cage has a Link Activity lamp and a Status lamp. The jacks carry them in their keyway corners. The image shows four small triangular windows per cage column in the metal band between the two cage rows, two pointing down and two up; they are read as the two lamps of the upper port (the down-pointing ones, at 2.05 and 9.46 mm from the column edge) and of the lower port (the up-pointing ones, at 5.0 and 12.4), the left one of each pair being Link Activity by analogy with the jacks. No figure says which window is which, so the assignment is estimated. The Status lamp shows what the mode lamps select (Table 25), so its states cannot be one vocabulary here.

port-numbering.note: The legends under each column read 0 up-arrow, down-arrow 1, then 2 and 3 up to 22 and 23, so the upper jack of a column is the even port; all are white on this model. The cages print 0 up-arrow, down-arrow 1, 2 up-arrow, down-arrow 3 under each group, and the right group is bracketed and labelled UPLINK. The left group is the Virtual Chassis ports. The numbers are as printed, from 0. Interface names are not printed on the metal and the guide's Junos listing is for a 48-port model, so none is recorded for this one beyond the cage numbering.

ports.note: Table 13 and Figure 18 - 24 RJ-45 ports in two rows of 12 columns, then two 2x2 groups of SFP+ cages. The columns are in two shells. The right shell has eight columns on the registry's 13.97 pitch, the first cell at 244.15 mm, which is where the 48T's third shell stands. The left shell has four columns and they are NOT on that pitch: their cavities centre at 183.5, 199.4, 215.1 and 231.0 mm, a step of 15.8 mm, against 13.98 in the right shell. The four are placed on 15.83 mm (the 5/8 in step), cell edge at 177.15 mm. The rows centre 14.0 mm apart, the upper row turned 180 so that its keyway and lamps face up, as the image shows. The cages are two columns by two rows, abutting on the registry's 14.25 pitch, at 360.1 and 391.8 mm; the registry's 15.0 row pitch is used.

power.note: Tables 12, 21 and 27 - a 65 W AC supply, 100 to 240 V, 50/60 Hz; at most 55 W input. The model has no PoE. The rear legend prints 2.5A Max.

rear.note: Figures 17 and 19 and the 48T's rear photograph for the parts the two share. From the left - the MGMT RJ-45 over a USB 2.0 Type-A port in one housing, the CON RJ-45, a lighter plate with two bare holes and the earth symbol to its right, the ESD socket and symbol below the plate, one round fan at 115.2 mm, a label field and the AC inlet at 402.2 mm with its legend above (AC INPUT 100-240V 50-60Hz 2.5A Max, printed on the metal). Five screws stand along the lower edge. The label corner marks across the middle frame the serial number and CLEI labels (callouts 4 and 6). Stickers are regions and are not drawn.

reset.note: Figure 18 callout 9 - the reset button is the small round pinhole between the legends of the two jacks of column 10, at 334.3 mm, below the jacks. It sits between two legend arrows closer than the library's 4 mm button part is wide, so it is drawn as a pinhole in the metal and not placed as a part. The Factory Reset/Mode button (callout 5) is the blue one and is a part.

scale.note: Gate 1 - Figure 16 is 1500 px wide with the face 1306 px across, 2.962 px/mm against 440.9 mm, and 131 px high, 2.99 px/mm against 43.7 mm: 1 percent apart, so it is orthographic and carries geometry. The jack pitch of the right-hand shell reads 41.4 px, 13.98 mm, the registry's 13.97 mm on a quantity the scale never saw. Horizontal positions are measured from the centre of the face. The 48T photograph (3.19 px/mm) agrees with this figure on every feature the two share to within 0.6 mm, so the vertical positions are the 48T's. Every position is estimated, good to about half a millimetre across and one down.

sources.note: EX4100-F Switch Hardware Guide, Juniper Networks, PDF created 2026-10-01 (271 pages; https://www.juniper.net/documentation/us/en/hardware/ex4100-f/ex4100-f.pdf): Tables 3 to 5, 12, 13, 18, 21 to 27 and 45, Figures 16 to 19 (the front and rear views and their callouts), the mounting topics. Figures 16 and 17 are 1500 px wide studio images of the real unit and are the pictures measured here, extracted from the PDF. The maker's image library holds no photograph of the EX4100-F-24T (ex4100-f-24t-front-high.jpg returned an HTML 404 page, tried once), so the 48T's photographs were used only to cross-check the parts the two share. The HPE PSNow datasheet (a00150781enw) was tried once and did not answer, so no datasheet figure is used. Nothing of the guide is copied here: every face is drawn new from measurements. No Visio stencil, 3D model or other held photograph of the EX4100-F was available, so none was used. End of life was searched 2026-10-22: no Juniper notice for the EX4100-F was found (a reseller tracker lists the EX4100 family as supported with no dates), so the lifecycle is none announced.

status-block.note: Figures 18 and 28 and Tables 22 and 25 - a dark plate at the right end holds the chassis lamps SYS, ALM, MST and CLD (left column) and the port mode lamps SPD, DX and EN (right column, three rows: the PoE lamp is not available on a model without PoE, Table 25 note, and the image prints no PoE legend), each lamp above its legend, a round blue Factory Reset/Mode button with a list icon and the USB Type-C console (CON). The columns centre at 425.9 and 431.6 mm. The lamps are very faint and are placed from their legends.
